User story: As a user, I want to register and log in with email/password to access the dashboard.
As a user, I want to sign in with Google.
As an invited user, I want to set my password via a secure link.
As a user, I want to view and edit my profile.
As a platform admin, I want to create update and delete users.
As a platform admin, I want to resend an invite to a user.
As an owner, I want to create update and delete projects.
As an owner, I want to duplicate a project to replicate structure.
As an owner, I want to add and remove project members with roles.
As the system, I must enforce project-scoped access and RBAC.
As an owner, I want to store per-project API keys encrypted.
As a user, I want global user credentials with project fallback.
As an owner, I want to edit AI prompts for generation.
As an editor, I want to manage sites with WP URL Sheets and Pinterest URL.
As an editor, I want to upload media to WP from file or URL.
As an editor, I want full recipe CRUD per site.
As an editor, I want to publish a generated article to WordPress.
As an editor, I want to start an articles job for bulk AI generation.
As an editor, I want to start a publisher job to push to WordPress.
As an editor, I want job history detail and live logs.
As an editor, I want to stop a job and revert generating recipes to pending.
As the system, I must generate full recipe JSON article meta category keyword via OpenAI.
As the system, I must add internal links from the site sitemap.
As the system, I must generate images via Discord Midjourney with global serialization.
As the system, I must cache Discord CDN images to local uploads.
As an editor, I want shared-input generation across multiple sites.
As an owner, I want scheduled automatic publishing and image retention settings.
As an owner, I want to trigger scheduled publish run now.
As an owner, I want controlled batch publish.
As the system, I must publish to WordPress with multi-account support.
As the system, I must write permalink back to Google Sheet when configured.
As an editor, I want Pinterest OAuth connect and status.
As an editor, I want to create pins from recipes including bulk.
As an editor, I want to list Pinterest boards.
As an editor, I want to generate a pin image from template and fields.
As a user, I want CRUD custom pin templates with Fabric canvas JSON.
As an editor, I want bulk pin generation for site or job.
As an owner, I want Excel export for project site or recipes.
As a user, I want to import boards list from Excel template.
As a user, I want custom fonts for visuals.
As an owner, I want image retention cleanup and manual cleanup run.
As ops, I want stale jobs reconciled after restart.
As a user, I want a dashboard with project site recipe job stats.
As a user, I want consistent navigation layout and dark dashboard UI.
As a business, I want Terms and Privacy pages.
As a user, I want Threads projects and linked accounts with OAuth.
As a user, I want create schedule publish Threads posts and batch publish.
As the system, I must upload Threads media and cleanup expired media.
As ops, I want Docker Compose and env-based configuration.
As the system, I apply CORS security headers and hide OpenAPI in prod.
As a client, I want manual QA bugfixes and UX on critical flows.
